vizedit.error.invalid: 无效的编辑内容，请检查名称、属性和数据格式。
Invalid edit. Check the name, properties and data format.
vizedit.error.conflict: 目标或受影响后代已发生变化，请重新打开编辑器；当前草稿仍保留。
The target or affected descendants changed. Reopen the editor; your draft is preserved.
vizedit.error.duplicate: 此维度已存在同名域名。
An area with this name already exists in this dimension.
vizedit.error.children: 存在子域名，不能删除此域名。
This area has children and cannot be deleted.
vizedit.error.level: 域名等级必须为正整数，且改级后的后代等级不能溢出。
Area levels must be positive integers; descendant levels must remain within range.
vizedit.error.parent: 上级域名必须比本域名高一级；一级域名只能挂接当前维度或不设置上级。
The parent must be exactly one level above; level 1 areas may only use the current dimension or no parent.
vizedit.error.cycle: 域名层级存在循环引用。
The area hierarchy contains a cycle.
vizedit.error.denied: 缺少本次变更所需权限，整笔修改未保存。
You lack a permission required for this change. Nothing was saved.
vizedit.error.color: 颜色必须是 #RRGGBB 或受支持的闪烁颜色。
Use a #RRGGBB color or a supported flashing color.
vizedit.error.altitude: 高度必须介于 -64 与 320 之间，且下限不能高于上限。
Height limits must be between -64 and 320, with the minimum no greater than the maximum.
vizedit.error.no_changes: There are no changes to save.
vizedit.error.dimension: 此编辑仅支持玩家当前的主世界、下界或末地。
Editing supports only the player's current Overworld, Nether or End.
vizedit.error.session: 编辑会话已失效，请重新打开编辑器；当前草稿仍保留。
The editing session expired. Reopen the editor; your draft is preserved.
vizedit.error.size: 编辑数据超过传输大小限制。
The editing data exceeds the transfer limit.
vizedit.error.timeout: 数据传输超时，当前草稿仍保留。
The transfer timed out. Your draft is preserved.
vizedit.error.storage: 保存文件失败，当前草稿仍保留。
The file could not be saved. Your draft is preserved.
vizedit.message.saved: 域名及必要后代已一起保存。
The area and affected descendants were saved together.
vizedit.message.submitted: 可视化编辑申请已提交审批，正式域名尚未改变。
The visual edit was submitted for approval. Published areas are unchanged.
vizedit.message.draft: 可视化审批草稿已保存。
The visual approval draft was saved.
vizedit.message.resubmitted: 可视化编辑申请已重新提交审批。
The visual edit was resubmitted for approval.
